summary: Calibre Web Automated is a self-hosted e-book management tool that combines a lightweight web user interface with the backend processing features of Calibre. It is designed as a fork of Calibre-Web to provide an integrated solution for organising, reading, and managing digital libraries.
goodFor: This is a good fit for users who want to host their own e-book collection behind a web interface while retaining the heavy-duty metadata and conversion capabilities of Calibre.
watchOut: Maintenance activity is moderate, meaning you may need to rely on the community or your own troubleshooting if you encounter edge cases or bugs.
deployNotes: Because it runs in Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your library files and database, along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
